_note: Contiki-NG on the ESP32-C6 (github.com/joakimeriksson/contiki-ng-esp32, -DCONTIKI_NULLNET=ON) as an unmodified IDF app: Contiki's own scheduler, CSMA and 802.15.4 stack over the emulated MAC, broadcasting every 5 s and blinking the WS2812 through the RMT. bb_init is the PHY blob's baseband calibration, as for the energy scanner.
